description: Mali: Situation des inondations is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by Mali WASH Cluster. This dataset outlines the population and household figures affected by flooding, categorized by gender, in Mali for the year 2024 at the administrative level 1. Coverage: Mali. The portal files it under the publisher Mali WASH Cluster. Its tags are affected population, climate-weather, flooding, gender and age disaggregated data-gadd, hazards and risk. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2025-08-06 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
